title: Research: screen selected rank-two macro fusion
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Extends the selected-source rank-two macro-fusion screen with an exact operator audit of its named phase-B witness. The rank-one recipes `0→2` and `2→252` compose to the pinned rank-two recipe `0→252`: exact Gaussian-dyadic matrices agree on all 512 basis columns, with matching canonical operator digest.

The intervening ADD still blocks direct replacement. In the forward trace, `L195_out = D x + (1/2) B y`, where `D=BA` and `y=L521`. In the backward trace, the caller also observes the intermediate value through `L521_out = y - (1/2) A x`. The available rank-two recipe emits only `D x`; it does not supply either missing block. A separate rank-one-equivalent tap produces the profile `[2,1]`, whose ideal recursive charge `2^(1-a)+1` is greater than the original `[1,1]` charge `2` for `0<a<1`, before conversion and restoration costs.

Across both orientations, 35 endpoint-matching candidates remain interrupted by scalar work, and all 100 candidate/add-operand instances lack a reusable same-key transition. This is a positive exact composition identity and a negative result for the selected single-output replacement contract. No multi-output provider, new supplier or κ improvement is claimed; selected κ remains `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, narrowed to successive same-register rank-one climbs and their intervening scalar operation. The fresh overlap refresh covered 734 open PRs and 2,596 Discussions with complete pagination. The query surfaced [PR #3998](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3998), a different staged544 scalar-ADD graph. [PR #1836](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1836) and its [`complex-heterogeneous-child-interface` audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/main/research/complex-heterogeneous-child-interface/README.md) study simultaneous unequal-rank pairing, not this sequential pair with an observable intermediate. Novelty remains scoped to this contract.

## Validation

The registered package passed its metadata/source-pin check and normal plus optimized CPython 3.12 replays:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-macro-fusion-screen --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-macro-fusion-screen
```

The replay checks both source orientations, the complete 597-event `L195` windows, the exact 512-column child composition, stored operator digests, nonzero ADD taps, same-key reuse census, and wrong-rank/source-removal controls. Evidence and hashes are in `RESULT.json`.

## Credit

Credit Cinna Davis / PR #1836 and Adam Gall's `complex-heterogeneous-child-interface` audit for the simultaneous unequal-rank census and reciprocal-encoding classification; credit the selected PR #1094 provider lineage and its pinned source audit. Prepared by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

## Open next questions

Only a changed multi-output/tap provider could absorb this witness's intermediate while retaining the exact operator. The pinned recipes expose one vector output, and the separated rank-two-plus-rank-one profile is already more expensive. A multi-output vector-decoder test would need its own exact input/output contract and complete copy, frame, precision and restoration invoice; it belongs to the separate vector-decoding proposal rather than an expansion of this stopped direct-fusion screen.
